response.goal: Automate a daily Airtable digest of yesterday's new orders, their total value, and urgent orders, posted to Slack at 8:00 skipping weekends using n8n or Make.

plan.step: Configure the Airtable trigger or scheduled node in n8n to query yesterday's new orders and filter for urgent status.
Aggregate the orders data to calculate total value and format the summary message including urgent orders.
Set up a scheduled time trigger for 8:00 on weekdays only, skipping weekends.
Publish the formatted digest to the #ops channel via Slack integration.

milestones.name: Workflow Implementation
milestones.deliverable: Fully functional n8n workflow connecting Airtable, schedule logic, and Slack

proof_map.step: Configure the Airtable trigger or scheduled node in n8n to query yesterday's new orders and filter for urgent status.
Aggregate the orders data to calculate total value and format the summary message including urgent orders.
Set up a scheduled time trigger for 8:00 on weekdays only, skipping weekends.
Publish the formatted digest to the #ops channel via Slack integration.

risks.risk: Airtable API rate limits or formula filtering edge cases for date ranges.
risks.mitigation: Test the query payload thoroughly in n8n to ensure accurate extraction of yesterday's orders.

risks.risk: Timezone discrepancies causing the digest to run at the wrong local time.
risks.mitigation: Explicitly configure the n8n scheduler node timezone to match the client's local ops schedule.

questions: What is the exact field name in Airtable for the order date and the urgent status?
Should the summary thread or send a single message block in the #ops Slack channel?
assumptions: The client has an active n8n instance or Make account ready for workflow deployment.
The budget of $30–$50 per hour covers the full end-to-end setup and testing time.
